description: This PHP source file defines the Language Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates language-related data for an employee and provides methods for normalization and data retrieval, including conversion to an array representation. The class integrates traits and interacts with Employee entities to fetch language information.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A DTO representing an employee's language information, capable of normalizing data and converting it to an array format for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language DTO with the specified employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the language data related to the employee into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter methods used to extract data from Employee language entities.
